evidence.title: 御製别有洞天詩（圓明園四十景詩）
evidence.excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製别有洞天詩
苑牆東出水闗曰秀清村長薄疎林映帶莊墅自有塵外致正不必傾岑峻磵阻絶恒蹊罕得津逮也
几席絶塵囂草木清且淑即此凌霞標何須三十六
evidence.summary: Beyond the water gate on the east wall lies 秀清村, with thin woods and farmhouses. It has an air of being outside the world without the need for steep cliffs and blocked paths.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考: 秀清村
evidence.excerpt_zh: 苑牆東出水闗曰秀清村

evidence.title: 秀清村
evidence.locator: v3 p.39, under 别有洞天; source ref 1-227
evidence.excerpt_zh: 近水楼台境秀清，满庭花木益敷荣。疏帘风静燕来睇，曲沼波新鸥结盟。柳扬长条汀畔舞，兰舒雅馥座前萦。授时最喜甘霖足，趁润郊原恰始耕。
evidence.summary: Poem 秀清村 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

evidence.title: 秀清村即景书怀
evidence.locator: v3 p.38, under 别有洞天; source ref 1-110
evidence.excerpt_zh: 春山润而秀，春水澄且清。泽透景物丽，普遍卉木荣。风静尘不起，波影含空明。泛舟坐天上，俯仰多怡情。眺览见仁智，集虚鲜外营。四郊农务起，土润宜新耕。耤田欲将事，终亩偕公卿。勤勤始东作，切切望西成。游观聊寓目，民瘼中心萦。
evidence.summary: Poem 秀清村即景书怀 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 别有洞天.

evidence.title: Scene 34, 别有洞天 Bieyou Dongtian
evidence.excerpt_other: It led, as through a cave, to "another sky" and to a small lake surrounded by houses called Hsiu Ch'ing Ts'un, or Beautiful Pure Village.
evidence.summary: A fortified water gate over the stream behind the hill at the south-east corner of 福海, leading to a small lake and 秀清村 Xiuqing Cun.

evidence.title: “洞天福地”说与圆明园“别有洞天”之景观构造
evidence.summary: Links 别有洞天 Bieyou Dongtian to Daoist cave-heaven ideas and to Yongzheng's alchemy here. 100 x 170 m, 2,050 m2 of buildings, the figures of 百景图志.

evidence.title: 老北京的记忆(133): 圆明园别有洞天遗址, quoting 《圆明园百景图志》
evidence.summary: Scene by scene history and sizes. 1751 main hall rebuilt as three linked rolls and 纳翠楼 added; about 1761 the west side redone after 保定 莲池书院, naming Qianlong's own note. 水木清华之阁 two storeys, 时赏斋 a raised hall. Second-hand: blog quoting 百景图志.

evidence.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析
evidence.summary: Dates three NLC Yangshi Lei water-course plans (about 1:2000) by the changes they show. It lists dated works: 1803 channel from 宁和镇 to 秀清村; 1810 镜远洲 at 平湖秋月; 1811 恒春堂; after 1828 清晖阁 replaced by 湛静斋; 1831 慎德堂; 1836 九州清晏殿 reduced to five bays with 同道堂 added west; 1846 洞天深处 four courts to two.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
